svg.desc: Cocoon Cabin English portfolio. 2560 x 1440 SVG with an embedded 3840 x 2160 background and editable Inter text.

text.tspan: Study interfaces, space and gestures separately; bring the complete experience together in Unity / Quest.

Hand shapes, hold times and confirmation

Solid lines: asset import. Dashed line: interaction-rule reference. Web and Unity are independent. Seat image: presentation render of the original Seat V2 model.
